<!-- All news items below this line -->{{Current events|year=2008|month=09|day=9|content=

* [[UNITA]] accepts defeat in the [[Angolan legislative election, 2008]], the first parliamentary elections in [[Angola]] in 16 years, in which the ruling [[Popular Movement for the Liberation of Angola]] wins more than 80% of the votes. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/africa/7605454.stm (BBC)]
* [[Al Franken]] wins a [[Partisan primary|primary election]] for the [[Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party]] to challenge incumbent [[Senate of the United States|Senator]] [[Norm Coleman]] in the [[United States Senate election in Minnesota, 2008|Minnesota Senate election]]. [http://ap.google.com/article/ALeqM5hvonEK0aSFP9aZpT3p6uUTlUQ_GwD933IPH81 (AP via Google News)]{{Dead link|date=August 2019 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}
* The [[military of Sri Lanka]] declares 12 of its soldiers and one policeman killed in a suicide attack by the [[Tamil Tigers]] in [[Mullaittivu]]. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/south_asia/7605498.stm (BBC News)]
* [[Prime Minister of Malaysia]] [[Abdullah Ahmad Badawi]] states that the governing [[United Malays National Organisation]] (UMNO) will punish [[Ahmad Ismail (Malaysian politician)|Ahmad Ismail]], a party official, for a series of statements he made about [[Malaysia]]'s [[Malaysian Chinese|ethnic Chinese]] population. [http://online.wsj.com/article/SB122096793343314743.html (''Wall Street Journal'')]
* The [[United Nations]] decides to withdraw aid workers from [[Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam|Tamil Tiger]]-held areas of [[Sri Lanka]]. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/south_asia/7606864.stm (BBC News)]
* [[Hurricane Ike]] makes its second landfall on [[Cuba]], near [[San Cristóbal, Cuba|San Cristóbal]], north of the [[Isla de la Juventud|Isle of Youth]], on its way into the [[Gulf of Mexico]]. [http://www.cnn.com/2008/US/weather/09/09/hurricane.ike/index.html (CNN)]
* A [[Thailand|Thai]] court rules that [[Prime Minister of Thailand|Prime Minister]] [[Samak Sundaravej ]] must be removed from office for receiving payment for appearing on a television [[cooking show]].  [https://web.archive.org/web/20080917220729/http://ap.google.com/article/ALeqM5hG71oGl1LokvZphtDQZzL44nzc3QD933CQI80 (AP via Google News)]
* US President [[George W. Bush]] pledges 4,500 troops to [[Afghanistan]] over the next few months and orders 8,000 troops currently stationed in [[Iraq]] to be home by February. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/bush-promises-more-troops-for-afghanistan-1.765146 (CBC News)]
* [[Apple Inc.]] unveils the revamped [[iPod]] line-up including the redesigned, fourth-generation [[iPod Nano]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/musicNews/idUSN0929983020080909 (Reuters)]
* Georgian opposition members demand [[President of Georgia]] [[Mikheil Saakashvili]]'s resignation. Saakashvili believes he will "survive the crisis politically". [https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/article/2008/09/08/AR2008090802449_pf.html (Washington Post)][http://www.newstin.com/tag/us/76513010 (Newstin)]
